result.stdout:
Lifeblood — Compiler truth in, AI context out
https://github.com/user-hash/Lifeblood

Usage:
  lifeblood analyze --project <path>                         Analyze via Roslyn
  lifeblood analyze --graph <graph.json>                     Analyze JSON graph
  lifeblood analyze --project <path> --rules hexagonal        Analyze + built-in rules
  lifeblood analyze --project <path> --rules <rules.json>    Analyze + custom rules
  lifeblood context --project <path>                         Generate AI context pack (JSON)
  lifeblood context --project <path> --format md             Generate instruction file (markdown)
  lifeblood export  --project <path>                         Export graph as JSON (stdout)
  lifeblood export  --project <path> --out <file>            Export graph as JSON to file
  lifeblood verify  --incremental --project <path>           Full vs incremental edge-count drift check (INV-INCREMENTAL-XREF-001)

Built-in rule packs: hexagonal, clean-architecture, lifeblood
